verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a batch API to scrape up to 25,000 URLs or crawl large sites asynchronously, with progress tracking and retrieval when the job finishes (docs-34, docs-3). It also offers synchronous multi-page crawls of up to 500 pages (docs-2) and queued prefetch for brand data (docs-31). missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of batch jobs at scale, and no documented bulk/batch mode for brand, people-enrichment or news lookups beyond prefetch.
